jobs.description: As a Site Procurement Manager for the Amazon Fulfillment Center team, you will serve as the bridge between centralized Procurement and the building leadership. You will own the site’s indirect procurement operation responsibilities at a site level, including vendor management of 3rd party service providers, purchase order management, and inventory management. You will lead supplier management KPI and metrics reporting, and work with stakeholders to find and understand deviation and improvement areas. You will provide procurement leadership and align with the building leadership team to drive efficiencies and improvements at the site(s). Key job responsibilities • Provide procurement operations support for fulfillment centers, including managing suppliers (goods and services), non-inventory labor, flow and space models, cycle counts, inventory management, and procurement transactions. • Ensure compliance with organizational KPIs, working with the non-inventory team to measure, control, and benchmark procurement processes. • Develop expertise in non-inventory items and collaborate with similar buildings to implement best practices. • Build relationships across the network, ensuring the sharing and implementation of best practices. This includes training teams such as Operations, Loss Prevention, PXT, Transportation, Facilities Management, and Safety on procurement processes. • Work with internal teams, Finance, and Procurement Operations to understand budgetary targets and establish methods for measuring savings, value, and category metrics. • Assist Finance and internal teams in determining budgets and managing blanket POs. • Monitor supplier performance using tools such as supplier scorecards and Global Audit Tools for 3P suppliers. Collaborate with Category and Global Supplier Management to drive improvements across categories like janitorial, food service, pest control, landscaping, snow removal, water coolers, PPE, and waste management. • Ensure 3P suppliers comply with site-level contracts and service terms, including SLA response times. • Track and measure savings performance, developing action plans to meet goals and reduce waste in FC procurement processes. Standardize best practices across the network. • Collaborate with both internal teams and suppliers to develop innovative procurement solutions that support Operations. • Implement methods to track supplier performance and drive continuous improvement. • Partner with AP, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve vendor payment issues promptly. • Support Procure-to-Pay execution and local sourcing activities to meet business needs. • Assist the centralized Procurement team (GPCS) and Global Procurement Organization (GPO) pillars, including ProcOps, Category, Supplier Diversity, Supplier Management, Procurement Excellence, Reusables, Technology, and PMO. • Work in a warehouse environment, requiring frequent walking and adaptability to varying temperatures due to open dock doors. • Other responsibilities as assigned by your manager • This position requires regular travel to assigned site(s); travel distances may exceed 50 miles depending on business needs.

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
You will join the Grok Voice Model team to help build the world’s best voice AI. We deliver smooth, natural, low-latency spoken interactions — expressive, multilingual, and reliable across devices and real-time scenarios. We own the full training pipeline: massive data curation, premium audio processing, frontier speech-language pre-training, and intensive post-training to push quality, speed, and stability to the limit.
Our goal: make talking to AI feel like conversing with the most charming, kind, and knowledgeable person imaginable. We’re seeking exceptionally smart, execution-oriented engineers to help us get there.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and execute large-scale speech data curation and processing pipelines, including collection of diverse real-world audio, synthetic data generation, and automated annotation workflows to enable high-quality model training and evaluation.
Work on pre-training and post-training of speech-language models, with targeted enhancements through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and other techniques to ensure Grok Voice responses are accurate, factually grounded, natural and idiomatic in spoken style, conversational in tone, and fluent across multiple languages.
Build and iterate a comprehensive evaluation framework covering objective metrics (accuracy, quality, latency, expressiveness), human preference studies, content factuality assessments, real-time interaction quality, and experimentation infrastructure to measure and improve performance.
Work closely with product teams to integrate voice models into applications and real-time environments, define spoken interaction specifications, and handle the full lifecycle from prototype to global-scale deployment for stable, low-latency, delightful voice experiences.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Python expert with deep proficiency in writing clean, efficient code for AI/ML systems.
Hands-on experience processing large-scale datasets using tools like Spark and Ray for cleaning, augmentation, and feature extraction.
Proficiency in pre-training and post-training speech-language models using JAX/PyTorch, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and optimizations for accuracy, factuality, natural spoken style, detail, and multilingual fluency.
Ability to set up and run rigorous evaluation pipelines: objective metrics, human preference studies, content factuality checks, and iterative A/B testing to drive model improvements.
Experience building or working with large-scale distributed training and inference systems on Kubernetes.
Proactive, self-driven attitude — ready to grind in a fast-paced, high-caliber team to deliver outstanding voice AI experiences.
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
$150,000 - $450,000 USD
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

회사 소개
CFS(Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화(Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 “쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?” 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
본 포지션은 외국인 임원을 직접 지원하는 Executive Assistant 역할로, 임원의 일정 및 업무를 지원하는 것을 넘어 조직 운영 전반이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 다양한 운영 업무를 수행하는 포지션입니다.
Executive Assistant는 임원의 가장 가까운 비즈니스 파트너 중 한 명으로서 복잡한 일정과 우선순위를 관리하고, 국내외 이해관계자들과 긴밀하게 협업하며 조직 운영을 지원하게 됩니다. 또한 글로벌 환경에서 영어를 활용하여 커뮤니케이션하며, 인터뷰 코디네이션, 데이터 및 리포팅 지원, 워크샵 및 이벤트 운영 등 다양한 업무를 담당하게 됩니다.
빠르게 변화하는 환경 속에서 스스로 필요한 업무를 발굴하고 실행할 수 있는 적극성(Proactive Mindset), 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 역량, 그리고 다양한 이해관계자들과 신뢰 관계를 구축할 수 있는 대인관계 역량을 갖춘 분을 찾고 있습니다.

실제 근무 중인 Executive Assistant들의 인터뷰를 통해 직무와 조직 문화를 보다 자세히 알아보실 수 있습니다.

jobs.description: Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a AMZL Performance Manager to own the end-to-end network performance monitoring, analysis, and improvement function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role sits within the Ops Excellence team, part of the Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization, covering the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large) programs. As an Individual Contributor, you will be the single-threaded owner of AMZL performance in a overall visibility — building and maintaining dashboards, conducting root cause analyses, tracking corrective actions, and providing data-driven recommendations that move operational metrics in the right direction. You will work closely with Operations, regional leadership, and cross-functional partners to ensure performance gaps are identified early, diagnosed accurately, and resolved systematically. This role reports directly to the Ops Excellence Manager and works cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Planning, and partner-facing teams to ensure network performance decisions are data-driven, scalable, and aligned with Last Mile Brazil's growth objectives. This position is based out of an AMZL office and may require periodic travel to delivery stations across Brazil. If you are passionate about operational analytics, performance management, and driving measurable improvement across a complex logistics network, come join our team. Key job responsibilities Own the end-to-end AMZL network performance view across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, providing a consolidated AMZL perspective on operational performance, defects, and trends Drive AMZL overall performance monitoring and improvement across key performance metrics: DEA, Last Mile BPS, Concessions, TPH, DPPH, OTD, FPY, Scorecard, and SIR Build and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide real-time visibility into network performance, partner performance, and operational KPIs Conduct root cause analyses for performance deviations, identifying top offenders and structural defects across the partner network Develop and track corrective action plans in partnership with Operations and regional leadership, ensuring accountability and follow-through on short and mid-term improvements Establish and maintain KPI governance mechanisms — defining thresholds, escalation triggers, and performance review cadences (daily/weekly/monthly) Produce the weekly and monthly AMZL Network Performance Reports, including trend analysis, deep-dives on underperformers, and corrective action status across all partner programs Support partner performance guidance by translating Amazon's operational standards into actionable insights and recommendations for logistics partners Identify patterns and systemic issues across the network, escalating structural problems to the Ops Excellence Manager with data-backed recommendations Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Planning, and Procurement to align health diagnostics with broader business objectives Conduct periodic benchmarking analyses across nodes, clusters, and regions to identify performance gaps and best-practice sharing opportunities Present network performance insights and improvement recommendations in governance forums (DDD/WBR/MBR), framing findings with business impact and clear calls-to-action A day in the life Your day starts early — reviewing the automated daily health pulse across all EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL nodes. You spot a DEA drop at three stations in the Southeast cluster and immediately pull the granular data: it's a scan compliance issue tied to a recent route restructuring. By mid-morning, you've completed the root cause analysis and logged it in the corrective action tracker with a clear owner and 72-hour follow-up. You send a concise escalation summary to the regional Ops lead with recommended actions. Before lunch, you finalize the weekly Network Performance Report. This week's highlights: OTD improved 2pp network-wide after last month's UTR process change, but Concessions spiked in the North region. You prepare the talking points for the WBR — crisp, data-backed, with clear "ask" for leadership. After lunch, you deep-dive into a recurring pattern you've been tracking: three nodes with consistently high Ageing 3+ despite corrective actions. You build a hypothesis — shift handoff gaps during multi-cycle operations — and flag it to the Process Improvement leads for structural investigation. Late afternoon, you update your performance governance dashboard, adding a new automated alert for FPY drops below threshold. You also prep a partner support brief for an AMPL partner whose Scorecard has been trending red for two consecutive weeks. You close the day in a 1:1 with your manager (Ops Excellence Manager), reviewing your weekly priorities, sharing the systemic patterns you've identified, and aligning on next week's deep-dive focus areas. About the team The Network Performance function is part of the Ops Excellence team within Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. We support the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission within Ops Excellence is to ensure Last Mile delivery metrics consistently move in the right direction by monitoring network performance, diagnosing defects, and driving data-powered corrective actions. The AMZL Performance Manager is the "eyes of the network" — providing the performance intelligence that fuels process improvement, operational standardization, and partner support across the entire PSX ecosystem.

Créer et ajuster des mécanismes de détection, réduire les alertes inutiles, cerner les lacunes en matière de télémétrie et tirer parti des leçons apprises lors d’incidents pour renforcer les guides d’intervention et de surveillance. Collaborer avec les parties prenantes techniques et non techniques, communiquer clairement les risques et les décisions relatives aux interventions, et contribuer à mener à bien les initiatives de sécurité interfonctionnelles. 회사 소개
쿠팡의 핀테크 사업은 소비자와 판매자 모두가 확장된 금융 서비스 솔루션을 누릴 수 있도록 새로운 방식을 선보이고 있습니다.
쿠팡페이는 Coupang.com 및 쿠팡이츠에서 상품을 구매하는 고객부터 쿠팡의 오픈마켓을 이용하는 판매자 그리고 쿠팡이츠 가맹점까지 쿠팡을 이용하는 모든 이들에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 서비스 솔루션을 제공하는 데 중점을 두고 있습니다. 쿠팡페이는 최신 기술을 통해 한국과 대만의 쿠팡 고객의 니즈에 부응하기 위해 원터치 결제 서비스와 같은 금융 솔루션을 개발합니다.
대출 분야에서는 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 와우 신용 카드 (제휴)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 쿠팡 입점 사업자(셀러)의 사업 성장을 위해 쿠팡페이는 한국 최초의 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 기능을 사용하여 다양한 유동성 옵션을 구축하고 있습니다.
금융과 기술을 결합한 핀테크 분야 내에서 광범위한 경험을 쌓으며 업무하시길 원한다면, 쿠팡 페이와 함께 하세요. 우리는 고객이 계산하는 시간을 줄여서 고객이 좋아하는 것을 쇼핑하는 데 더 많은 시간을 보낼 수 있도록 돕습니다.
직무 소개
Staff Product Designer는 전략 수립부터 실행까지 주요 제품 경험 전반을 주도하는 핵심 리더입니다.
숙련된 경험을 바탕으로 다양한 이해관계자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 본인의 디자인 비전과 아이디어를 구체화하고 최고 수준의 프로덕트를 설계할 수 있는 역량을 요구합니다.
실무형 디자인 리더 (Hands-on Design Leader): 쿠팡 제품 디자인팀은 실무형(Hands-on) 디자인 문화를 지향합니다. 우리는 리더가 디자인 문제를 해결할 때 사려 깊은 프로세스, 세련된 디자인, 고객 중심 관점을 보여주는 숙련된 디자이너가 되기를 기대합니다. 또한 팀 결과의 속도와 품질에 대한 책임을 지게 되므로, 팀을 이끌고 모든 세부 사항에서 우수성을 요구하는 데 자신감을 가져야 합니다.
전체적인 문제 해결사 (Holistic Problem Solver): 리더는 체계적으로 사고하고 직관과 근거(데이터, 모범 사례 벤치마크, 테스트 및 분석 등)를 활용하여 복잡한 고객 문제에 대한 혁신적인 해결책을 찾아야 합니다.
업무 내용
고객 경험을 위한 프로덕트 목표 달성 및 디자인 방향성 주도
비즈니스 리더, 프로덕트 매니저, 개발, 운영 및 마케팅 등 다양한 이해관계자와의 긴밀한 협업을 통한 전략적 방향성 설정
